RESULT: DONE
CHANGED: web/app/teams/[team_id]/workflow/WorkflowSettingsClient.tsx, web/app/mindmaps/[key]/board/WaitingOnYou.tsx, tests/integration/test_mindmap_workflow_web_ui_shapes.py, src/mem_mcp/web/handlers/workflows.py
TESTS: pytest tests/integration/test_mindmap_workflow_web_ui_shapes.py -q -> 10 passed, 10 warnings in 3.04s; ruff check src tests/integration/test_mindmap_workflow_web_ui_shapes.py -> All checks passed!; `npx tsc --noEmit` in web/ -> no output
CHECKLIST:
#1 FIXED WorkflowSettingsClient.tsx: item counts now cover every map of the team (map list, then work-items per map). Only populated removed positions need a target, and Activate stays disabled until all are mapped. A map with 500+ items blocks activation with a banner.
#2 NOT FIXED: remap checks targets against the active workflow, so it can only run after activation and the pair can't be atomic. On remap failure the mappings are kept and a "Retry remap" alert shows. The activate-then-fail window remains.
#3 FIXED: `wfstages` is gone. The draft's stages are fetched from `GET /workflow?workflow_id=<id>` (new optional query param in workflows.py), and Activate waits for them.
#4 FIXED test file: dropped the trivially true node_id assertion. Added source-level guards for the 400/404 branch in page.tsx and the node_id-only join in WaitingOnYou.tsx, plus an endpoint test for the draft fetch. These guards are string checks, not rendering tests.
#5 FIXED WaitingOnYou.tsx: the empty state now says "on this map", and a line shows how many sign-offs are waiting on other maps.
NOTES:
- Touched src/mem_mcp/web/handlers/workflows.py (outside my file list) to add the optional `workflow_id` query param to the GET workflow route.
- The test DB lacked the `team_workflows` table, so I ran `alembic upgrade head` before the tests would pass.
- The API's pending-signoffs rows also carry `memory_id`, so I couldn't assert its absence. The node_id join is guarded by the source check instead.
- No Next.js component or browser test exists, so the remap UI is only type-checked.
- Legacy items with no `current_stage` are counted by their `status`, assuming the work-items payload includes `status`.
